description: Metadata for a CMS dataset by datasetId (UUID, or a Provider Data Catalog id like "27ea-46a8"): title, description, total row count, last-modified date, themes/keywords, and downloadable resources (CSV files, data dictionaries). For Provider Data Catalog ids it also returns issued, modified, released and next-update dates, publisher, contact and the download link. Use after search_datasets to inspect a dataset before pulling rows.

datasetId.description: Dataset UUID from search_datasets, or a Provider Data Catalog id such as "27ea-46a8".

title: Cms Dataset Info
